arxiv-1612-09474.title: A generative angular model of protein structure evolution
arxiv-1612-09474.creator: Michael Golden, Eduardo García-Portugués, Michael Sørensen, Kanti V. Mardia, Thomas Hamelryck, Jotun Hein
arxiv-1612-09474.description: Abstract Recently described stochastic models of protein evolution have demonstrated that the inclusion of structural information in addition to amino acid sequences leads to a more reliable estimation of evolutionary parameters. We present a generative, evolutionary model of protein structure and sequence that is valid on a local length scale.

arxiv-2110-01706.title: Event-based hyperspectral EELS: towards nanosecond temporal resolution Journal: Ultramicroscopy
arxiv-2110-01706.creator: Yves Auad, Michael Walls, Jean-Denis Blazit, Odile Stéphan, Luiz H. G. Tizei, Mathieu Kociak, Francisco De la Peña, Marcel Tencé
arxiv-2110-01706.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Yves Auad, Michael Walls, Jean-Denis Blazit, Odile Stéphan, Luiz H. G. Tizei, Mathieu Kociak, Francisco De la Peña, Marcel Tencé. The acquisition of a hyperspectral image is nowadays a standard technique used in the scanning transmission electron microscope. It relates the spatial position of the electron probe to the spectral data associated with it.

arxiv-2111-06867.title: Flatee : Federated Learning Across Trusted Execution Environments Thanks: This paper appeared at IEEE EuroS&P 2021 as Poster [ 9 ] . Affiliation: Ashoka University, Sonipat, Haryana, India E-mail arup.mondal_phd19@ashoka.edu.in, yashrajmore29@gmail.com, hulikalruthu@gmail.com, debayan.gupta@ashoka.e
arxiv-2111-06867.creator: Arup Mondal, Yash More, Ruthu Hulikal Rooparaghunath, Debayan Gupta
arxiv-2111-06867.description: Abstract Federated learning allows us to distributively train a machine learning model where multiple parties share local model parameters without sharing private data. However, parameter exchange may still leak information. Several approaches have been proposed to overcome this, based on multi-party computation, fully homomorphic encryption, etc.

arxiv-2112-04992.title: A Markov process for an infinite age-structured population
arxiv-2112-04992.creator: Dominika Jasińska, Yuri Kozitsky
arxiv-2112-04992.description: Abstract . For an infinite system of particles arriving in and departing from a habitat X X – a locally compact Polish space with a positive Radon measure χ \chi – a Markov process is constructed in an explicit way.

arxiv-2208-08055.title: Performance Analysis and Optimization for RIS-Assisted Multi-User Massive MIMO Systems with Imperfect Hardware
arxiv-2208-08055.creator: Zhangjie Peng, Xianzhe Chen, Cunhua Pan, Maged Elkashlan, and Jiangzhou Wang
arxiv-2208-08055.description: Abstract The paper studies a reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS)-assisted multi-user uplink massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) system with imperfect hardware. At the RIS, the paper considers phase noise, while at the base station, the paper takes into consideration the radio frequency impairments and low-resolution analog-to-digital converters.

arxiv-2211-11851.title: Invariant Tensors for S ​ U ​ ( 3 ) SU(3) with Adjoints Preprint: UCI-HEP-TR 2022-25
arxiv-2211-11851.creator: Arvind Rajaraman
arxiv-2211-11851.description: Abstract We develop a method for finding the independent invariant tensors of a gauge theory. Our method uses a theorem relating invariant tensors and constant configurations in field space. We apply our method to an S ​ U ​ ( 3 ) SU(3) gauge theory with matter in the adjoint representation, and find the independent invariant tensors of this theory.

arxiv-2212-07491.title: Topological entropy of generalized Bunimovich stadium billiards Thanks: Research of Michał Misiurewicz was partially supported by grant number 426602 from the Simons Foundation.
arxiv-2212-07491.creator: Michał Misiurewicz, Hong-Kun Zhang
arxiv-2212-07491.description: Abstract . We estimate from below the topological entropy of the generalized Bunimovich stadium billiards. We do it for long billiard tables, and find the limit of estimates as the length goes to infinity. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary 37D50, 37B40 1.

arxiv-2412-08629.title: FlowEdit: Inversion-Free Text-Based Editing Using Pre-Trained Flow Models
arxiv-2412-08629.creator: Vladimir Kulikov Matan Kleiner Inbar Huberman-Spiegelglas Tomer Michaeli Technion – Israel Institute of Technology
arxiv-2412-08629.description: Abstract Editing real images using a pre-trained text-to-image (T2I) diffusion/flow model often involves inverting the image into its corresponding noise map. However, inversion by itself is typically insufficient for obtaining satisfactory results, and therefore many methods additionally intervene in the sampling process. Such methods achieve improved results but are not seamlessly transferable between model architectures.

arxiv-2508-07138.title: Strategic Incentivization for Locally Differentially Private Federated Learning
arxiv-2508-07138.creator: Yashwant Krishna Pagoti 1 , Arunesh Sinha 2 , Shamik Sural 1
arxiv-2508-07138.description: Abstract In Federated Learning (FL), multiple clients jointly train a machine learning model by sharing gradient information, instead of raw data, with a server over multiple rounds. To address the possibility of information leakage in spite of sharing only the gradients, Local Differential Privacy (LDP) is often used.

arxiv-2511-01664.title: The Orientalists’ Stance Towards Arabic Sciences (Especially Arabic Astronomy)
arxiv-2511-01664.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by . In this paper, we highlight the influence of Arab/Islamic civilization in the field of the history of astronomy on European historians. We also aim to elucidate the stance of Orientalists toward the study of Arab sciences and to clarify their orientations, with a particular focus on astronomy, while revealing the significant role played by Arab scholars in this domain and the impact of their contributions—especially astronomical tables (zij)—on Western astronomers.

doe-osti-3365489-progressing-analysis-of.title: Progressing Analysis of Variable Electric Rates (PAVER) Study
doe-osti-3365489-progressing-analysis-of.creator: Reeve, Hayden M., Bender, Sadie R., Smith, Lane D. et al.
doe-osti-3365489-progressing-analysis-of.description: U.S. Department of Energy technical report. The Progressing Analysis of Variable Electric Rates (PAVER) study analyzed the impact of a range of time-varying electric rates on the performance of a regional electric grid and the resulting costs for participating and non-participating customers. This analysis leveraged and ex

pmc-10536910.title: Interactive Learning for Network Anomaly Monitoring and Detection with Human Guidance in the Loop
pmc-10536910.creator: Dong Yang, Ze Liu, Songjie Wei, Rongxing Lu
pmc-10536910.description: With the advancement in big data and cloud computing technology, we have witnessed tremendous developments in applying intelligent techniques in network operation and management. However, learning- and data-based solutions for network operation and maintenance cannot effectively adapt to the dynamic security situation or satisfy administrators’ expectations alone.

pmc-11370065.title: Smoking, all-cause, and cause-specific mortality in individuals with diabetes in Mexico: an analysis of the Mexico city prospective study
pmc-11370065.creator: Daniel Ramírez-García, Carlos A Fermín-Martínez, Paulina Sánchez-Castro, Alejandra Núñez-Luna, Martín Roberto Basile-Alvarez, Luisa Fernández-Chirino, Arsenio Vargas-Vázquez, Juan Pablo Díaz-Sánchez, Ashuin Kammar-García, Paloma Almeda-Valdés, Jaime Berumen-Campos, Pablo Kuri-Morales, Roberto Tapia-
pmc-11370065.description: ObjectiveEvidence from low- and middle-income countries regarding the effect of smoking in people with diabetes is lacking. Here, we report the association of smoking with mortality in a large cohort of Mexican adults with diabetes.MethodsParticipants with diabetes mellitus (self-reported diagnosis, use of antidiabetic medications or HbA1c ≥ 6.

pmc-11475474.title: Changes in haptoglobin genotype-based gene expressions upon the observance of dawn-to-dusk intermittent fasting: a prospective cohort study on overweight and obese individuals
pmc-11475474.creator: Mohamed I. Madkour, Rasha E. Hassan, Naglaa M. Sherif, Samir Awadallah, Nada M. Farahat, Dana N. Abdelrahim, Fatima A. AlHasan, Jalal Taneera, MoezAlIslam E. Faris
pmc-11475474.description: IntroductionIntermittent fasting (IF) has been reported to be involved in ameliorating oxidative stress and lessening the systemic-low grade inflammation that predisposes to chronic diseases. Gene polymorphism is currently a main determining factor for the metabolic responses to different dietary and lifestyle modifications.

pmc-11508631.title: A Specialized Pipeline for Efficient and Reliable 3D Semantic Model Reconstruction of Buildings from Indoor Point Clouds
pmc-11508631.creator: Cedrique Fotsing, Willy Carlos Tchuitcheu, Lemopi Isidore Besong, Douglas William Cunningham, Christophe Bobda
pmc-11508631.description: Recent advances in laser scanning systems have enabled the acquisition of 3D point cloud representations of scenes, revolutionizing the fields of Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC). This paper presents a novel pipeline for the automatic generation of 3D semantic models of multi-level buildings from indoor point clouds. The architectural components are extracted hierarchically.

pmc-11635072.title: Enhancing synthetic vinasse treatment efficiency using an integrated UASB-Modified Bardenpho Process
pmc-11635072.creator: Afsaneh Mazaheri, Mohamad Reza Doosti, Mohammad javad Zoqi
pmc-11635072.description: Vinasse poses considerable environmental problems due to its complex composition of organic matter, minerals, and toxic compounds. If discharged into the environment without treatment, it can cause adverse impacts on ecosystems. This research investigated the effectiveness of an integrated treatment system involving an upflow anaerobic sludge blanket (UASB) reactor and the modified Bardenpho process (MBP) for purifying synthetic vinasse.

pmc-11677654.title: Antibiotic Resistance in Vibrio Bacteria Associated with Red Spotting Disease in Sea Urchin Tripneustes gratilla (Echinodermata)
pmc-11677654.creator: Mayan Ben Natan, Matan Masasa, Nadav Shashar, Lior Guttman, Eduardo Quiroz-Gúzman
pmc-11677654.description: The red spotting disease harms sea urchins to the extent of mass mortality in the ocean and echinocultures, accompanied by environmental damage and economic losses. The current study emphasizes the antimicrobial resistance of three isolated bacteria, closely related to Vibrio harveyi, Vibrio owensii, and Vibrio fortis, associated with red spotting in the cultured sea urchin Tripneustes gratilla.

pmc-12464206.title: Meta-analysis of comprehensive prognostic evaluation in patients with atrial fibrillation complicated by heart failure after catheter ablation
pmc-12464206.creator: Xiaoting Zhang, Meng Wei, Pengjie Xue, Baopeng Tang
pmc-12464206.description: Atrial fibrillation (AF) and heart failure (HF) often coexist, posing increased risks of HF events, rehospitalization, mortality, and stroke. While antiarrhythmic drugs have limitations, catheter ablation (CA) has emerged as a preferred rhythm control treatment for AF, yet its clinical outcomes remain inconclusive.

pmc-12816470.title: A high-quality genome assembly of angel-wing mushroom Pleurocybella porrigens that causes acute encephalopathy
pmc-12816470.creator: Nozomu Watanabe, Keisuke Mitsukuni, Koki Sekimata, Misuzu Kimura, Shoko Takada, Jili Zhang, Takumi Sato, Akiko Ono, Tomohiro Suzuki
pmc-12816470.description: In 2004, 59 cases of food poisoning linked to the consumption of the mushroom Pleurocybella porrigens were reported in Japan, resulting in 17 fatalities due to acute encephalopathy. In 2023, we found three components of this mushroom—a lectin (PPL), pleurocybelline (PC), and pleurocybellaziridine (PA)—which are collectively implicated in its toxicity in mice. Although we reported the genomic data for P.

pmc-13052761.title: Disease outbreak preparedness: a baseline assessment of infection prevention and control practice in healthcare facilities in Lagos, Nigeria
pmc-13052761.creator: Olorunfemi Olonire, Abiola Idowu, Kikelomo Wright, Olajide Sobande
pmc-13052761.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundEvidence-based infection prevention and control (IPC) measures in healthcare facilities are critical for preventing and containing outbreaks. However, studies have shown inadequate implementation of IPC practices among healthcare facilities in developing countries.

pmc-13446346.title: Late neurologic and functional outcomes in patients with severe anoxic brain injury after cardiopulmonary arrest: a multicenter cohort study
pmc-13446346.creator: Jayne Chu, Doanh Ly, Y Pham, Aileen Freer, Minetta Ralleca, Marlon Caballero, Baby Lyn Abadilla, Craig Hou
pmc-13446346.description: BackgroundNeurological prognostication after cardiac arrest remains challenging, and most patients with severe anoxic brain injury have an indeterminate prognosis despite multimodal assessment. Although delayed awakening has been reported in the era of targeted temperature management, long-term functional outcomes in this population remain poorly described.

pmc-13660818.title: A Universal van der Waals Tunneling Injector for Monolayer CMOS
pmc-13660818.creator: Hanbin Cho, Jing Huang, Seonguk Yang, Subin Im, Sangwoo Park, Jeongin Yeo, Sungyeon Kim, Gilhwan Do, Wenxuan Zhu, Soobeom Shin, Jongwon Lee, Yongjoon Shin, Do‐Sun Lee, Hu Young Jeong, Tae‐Eon Park, Jun Kang, Kyungmin Ko, Joonki Suh
pmc-13660818.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Two‐dimensional (2D) semiconductors are poised to extend logic technology to the atomic‐thickness limit, yet monolayer complementary metal‐oxide‐semiconductor (CMOS) has been largely hampered by polarity‐dependent, thermionic‐emission‐dominated contacts that preclude a unified injection solution. Here, we introduce degenerately doped, crystalline SnSe2 as a universal source‐side van der Waals (vdW) injector capable of enforcing all‐tunneling carrier injection into both p‐ and n‐type monolayer channels.
